title: A Progressive Training Strategy for Embodied Vision-Language Models to Mitigate Spatio-Temporal Hallucinations
abstract: arXiv:2604.10506v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made significant strides in static image understanding but continue to face critical hurdles in spatiotemporal reasoning. A major bottleneck is "multi-image reasoning hallucination", where a large performance drop between forward and reverse temporal queries reveals a dependence on superficial shortcuts instead of state-based understanding. To mitigate this, we first develop a new Chain-of-Thought (CoT) dataset that decomposes intricate reasoning into detailed spatiotemporal steps and definitive judgments. Building on this, we present a progressive training framework: it initiates with supervised pre-training on our CoT dataset to instill logical structures, followed by fine-tuning with scalable weakly-labeled data for broader generalization. translated_title: 一种缓解具身视觉语言模型时空幻觉的渐进式训练策略
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型在静态图像理解方面已取得显著进展，但在时空推理方面仍面临关键障碍。一个主要瓶颈是“多图像推理幻觉”，即模型在正向与反向时间查询之间出现大幅性能下降，这表明其依赖的是表面捷径而非基于状态的真实理解。为缓解这一问题，我们首先构建了一个新的思维链数据集，将复杂的推理过程分解为详细的时空步骤和明确的判断结论。在此基础上，我们提出了一个渐进式训练框架：首先在我们的思维链数据集上进行监督预训练以注入逻辑结构，随后使用可扩展的弱标注数据进行微调以实现更广泛的泛化能力。我们的实验表明，该方法不仅提升了骨干模型的准确率，还将正向-反向性能差距从70%以上大幅降低（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对具身视觉语言模型的“多图像推理幻觉”问题，提出了一种结合新型时空思维链数据集监督预训练与弱标注数据微调的渐进式训练策略，将正向-反向查询间的性能差距从70%以上大幅缩小。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a progressive training strategy—supervised pre-training on a newly constructed spatiotemporal Chain-of-Thought dataset followed by fine-tuning with scalable weakly-labeled data—to mitigate multi-image reasoning hallucinations in embodied vision-language models, reducing the forward-backward performance gap from over 70% to a significantly smaller value.
